diagnosis: A negative single-literal cube uses a noninverting control repeater before its data NOR torch. The explicit stage adds two ticks in the witness. This does not prove that all 837 regressions have this cause.
next_experiment_constraints: Preserve isolation between independent word rails and between output contributions.
Direct dust must retain sufficient signal at every actual torch support; removing a repeater alone is insufficient.
Preserve history and every frozen per-table waveform metric; do not compensate slower cases by fewer glitches.

experiment.rule: For every negative single-literal cube, replace the control repeater with descending dust and connect data NOR directly to its input signal.
